patch_description:
This version uses a path-obstruction archive search. It first extracts multiple C4-free scaffolds directly from differently ordered subsets of the input graph, including deliberately bounded source-derived scaffolds that avoid inheriting dense bad regions too early. Each scaffold is saturated by selecting legal insertions that minimize the number of remaining legal edges destroyed.

For local improvement, it scores deletable edges by the number of uniquely blocked length-three paths that use them. Removing such an edge makes several currently forbidden pairs potentially legal, so delete/refill kicks are targeted at genuine C4 obstructions rather than simply high-degree edges. Every insertion is checked locally, every candidate is validated through the common-neighbor characterization, and final repair is deletion-only if required.
